visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair, wearing a light blue camisole and a pink smartwatch, stands in front of a white brick wall. She holds a silver iPhone in her left hand and a pink and white stylus in her right, speaking with an animated facial expression and moving her mouth clearly. Behind her on the left is a yellow textured cloth draped over something. (2) She holds the iPhone closer to the camera, displaying a horizontal white document with black text on the screen. The lighting is bright and even across the scene. (3) The screen transitions to a recording of the iPhone interface, showing various app icons on a grey background. A finger taps and holds an icon, bringing up a menu where 'Scan Document' is highlighted. (4) The camera view on the phone shows a business card for 'Aotter Inc.' being scanned on a light surface. (5) Back to the woman, she continues to talk while holding the phone, gesturing with the stylus to emphasize her points. (6) Screen recording shows the scanned document being edited; a finger taps a '+' button and selects 'Add Signature'. A black screen appears for drawing a signature with a white line. (7) The signature is then placed and resized on the digital business card. (8) Finally, the woman waves her hands and smiles at the camera, concluding her explanation in the same indoor setting.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 你會在 iPhone 上簽文件嗎. (2) [Subtitle]: 我剛在那邊猛戳半天. (3) [Subtitle]: 差點都想用原子筆畫螢幕了. (4) [Subtitle]: 結果發現其實超簡單. (5) [Subtitle]: 首先把文件打開. (6) [Subtitle]: 或是長按備忘錄選擇掃描文件. (7) [Logo]: Aotter Inc. (8) [Subtitle]: 將文件放在畫面中. (9) [Subtitle]: 然後找到下面這個畫筆的圖案. (10) [Subtitle]: 進來後下面會看到一排工具列. (11) [Subtitle]: (口訣) 點右下角那個「+」. (12) [Subtitle]: 選加入簽名檔. (13) [Subtitle]: 如果你之前有簽過就會直接出現在這邊. (14) [Subtitle]: 沒簽過的話就用手指寫一個就好. (15) [Subtitle]: 直接在螢幕上簽就好囉. (16) [Subtitle]: 不要怕醜反正不是在寫書法. (17) [Subtitle]: 寫完點右上角完成. (18) [Subtitle]: 你的簽名就會飄進來了. (19) [Subtitle]: 接著用手把它移到你要簽的地方. (20) [Subtitle]: 還可以捏縮放. (21) [Subtitle]: 調整大小跟調整粗細. (22) [Subtitle]: 簽好以後按右上角完成. (23) [Subtitle]: 以後就不用列印出來簽名再掃描啦.
